last_message:
I added a new page, `docs/features/reminders.md`, explaining why pickup reminders go by SMS, and listed it in `docs/features/README.md`. I haven't committed anything.

**What the page covers:**
- **What members get:** one SMS the day before their pickup slot. It notes that `CHANNEL` in `larder/reminders.py` is what chooses between SMS and email.
- **Why SMS:** the email trial from April to June 2025, using only the facts in `notes/issue-52.md`:
  - 34% of the reminder emails were never opened.
  - Missed pickups rose from 6% to 13% of pantry orders, and each one meant a packed bag whose fresh food was thrown out by closing time.
  - Many members share one family phone and never check email.
  - Reminders went back to SMS on July 1, and missed pickups were back to 6% by August.
- **The opening of the page** says it was written because issue 52 was the third request this year to switch, and it links to that note.

**Choices I made:**
- **A feature page, not a decision record.** `docs/README.md` only allows a decision record for a choice that affects more than one module and can't be undone by one change. This choice lives in one module and changing one constant reverses it.
- **I left out my own conclusions.** I had first added a line saying what would justify reopening the question and a line weighing the SMS cost against the wasted food. Neither came from the repository and nobody was available to confirm them, so I removed both.
- **No year for the 40 euros a month.** Issue 52 doesn't say which year it was written, so the page gives the cost without a date.
